import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int Inf = 1000000000;
    static final int Maxn = 11;
    static final int MaxN = 205;
    static final int Maxd = 4;
    static final int[] dy = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
    static final int[] dx = {0, -1, 0, 1};

    static int n, t;
    static char[][] a = new char[Maxn][Maxn], b = new char[Maxn][Maxn];
    static int br, bc;
    static int[][] bum = new int[Maxn][Maxn];
    static int[][] dist = new int[Maxn][Maxn];
    static boolean[][] pos = new boolean[Maxn][Maxn];
    static int N;
    static int[][] R = new int[MaxN][MaxN];
    static List<Integer>[] neigh = new ArrayList[MaxN];
    static int[] F = new int[MaxN], P = new int[MaxN];
    static int res;

    static class Pair {
        int first, second;
        Pair(int first, int second) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
        }
    }

    static void BFS1() {
        for (int i = 0; i < Maxn; i++)
            Arrays.fill(bum[i], t);
        bum[br][bc] = 0;
        Queue<Pair> Q = new LinkedList<>();
        Q.offer(new Pair(br, bc));
        while (!Q.isEmpty()) {
            Pair v = Q.poll();
            int d = bum[v.first][v.second];
            for (int i = 0; i < Maxd; i++) {
                int u1 = v.first + dy[i];
                int u2 = v.second + dx[i];
                if (0 <= u1 && u1 < n && 0 <= u2 && u2 < n && a[u1][u2] != 'Y' && d + 1 < bum[u1][u2]) {
                    bum[u1][u2] = d + 1;
                    Q.offer(new Pair(u1, u2));
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void BFS2(int sr, int sc) {
        for (int i = 0; i < Maxn; i++)
            Arrays.fill(dist[i], Inf);
        for (int i = 0; i < Maxn; i++)
            Arrays.fill(pos[i], false);
        dist[sr][sc] = 0;
        pos[sr][sc] = true;
        Queue<Pair> Q = new LinkedList<>();
        Q.offer(new Pair(sr, sc));
        while (!Q.isEmpty()) {
            Pair v = Q.poll();
            int d = dist[v.first][v.second];
            pos[v.first][v.second] = d <= bum[v.first][v.second];
            if (d >= bum[v.first][v.second]) continue;
            for (int i = 0; i < Maxd; i++) {
                int u1 = v.first + dy[i];
                int u2 = v.second + dx[i];
                if (0 <= u1 && u1 < n && 0 <= u2 && u2 < n && a[u1][u2] != 'Y' && d + 1 < dist[u1][u2]) {
                    dist[u1][u2] = d + 1;
                    Q.offer(new Pair(u1, u2));
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void BFS(int sr, int sc, int[][] distArr, int InfVal) {
        for (int i = 0; i < Maxn; i++)
            Arrays.fill(distArr[i], InfVal);
        distArr[sr][sc] = 0;
        Queue<Pair> Q = new LinkedList<>();
        Q.offer(new Pair(sr, sc));
        while (!Q.isEmpty()) {
            Pair v = Q.poll();
            int d = distArr[v.first][v.second];
            for (int i = 0; i < Maxd; i++) {
                int u1 = v.first + dy[i];
                int u2 = v.second + dx[i];
                if (0 <= u1 && u1 < n && 0 <= u2 && u2 < n && a[u1][u2] != 'Y' && d + 1 < distArr[u1][u2]) {
                    distArr[u1][u2] = d + 1;
                    Q.offer(new Pair(u1, u2));
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int getFlow() {
        Arrays.fill(F, 0);
        F[0] = Inf;
        PriorityQueue<int[]> Q = new PriorityQueue<>((a, b) -> Integer.compare(b[0], a[0]));
        Q.offer(new int[]{Inf, 0});
        while (!Q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] top = Q.poll();
            int v = top[1], f = top[0];
            if (F[v] != f) continue;
            for (int u : neigh[v]) {
                int minF = Math.min(f, R[v][u]);
                if (minF > F[u]) {
                    F[u] = minF;
                    P[u] = v;
                    Q.offer(new int[]{F[u], u});
                }
            }
        }
        int v = N - 1;
        if (F[v] == 0) return 0;
        int flow = F[v];
        while (v != 0) {
            int u = P[v];
            R[u][v] -= flow;
            R[v][u] += flow;
            v = u;
        }
        return flow;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                a[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
                if (a[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    br = i;
                    bc = j;
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                b[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
            }
        }
        BFS1();
        N = 2 * n * n + 2;
        for (int i = 0; i < MaxN; i++) {
            neigh[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(a[i][j]) && a[i][j] > '0') {
                    int v = i * n + j + 1;
                    R[0][v] = a[i][j] - '0';
                    neigh[0].add(v);
                    neigh[v].add(0);
                    BFS2(i, j);
                    for (int i2 = 0; i2 < n; i2++) {
                        for (int j2 = 0; j2 < n; j2++) {
                            if (pos[i2][j2] && Character.isDigit(b[i2][j2]) && b[i2][j2] > '0') {
                                int u = n * n + i2 * n + j2 + 1;
                                R[v][u] = Inf;
                                neigh[v].add(u);
                                neigh[u].add(v);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(b[i][j]) && b[i][j] > '0') {
                    int u = n * n + i * n + j + 1;
                    R[u][N - 1] = b[i][j] - '0';
                    neigh[u].add(N - 1);
                    neigh[N - 1].add(u);
                }
            }
        }
        res = 0;
        int f;
        while ((f = getFlow()) != 0) {
            res += f;
        }
        System.out.println(res);
        sc.close();
    }
}
